description:
Returns the real-time price quote for a specific cryptocurrency.

    Common symbols: BTCUSD (Bitcoin), ETHUSD (Ethereum), SOLUSD (Solana),
    BNBUSD (BNB), XRPUSD (XRP), ADAUSD (Cardano), DOGEUSD (Dogecoin).

    yearHigh / yearLow are the feed's trailing-year range, roughly the past
    12-13 months: call them trailing-year figures. For a year-to-date or
    calendar-year change, a dated extreme or an exact 52-week figure use
    get_crypto_historical, since the quote does not date its extremes.

    Args:
        symbol: Cryptocurrency symbol (e.g. 'BTCUSD' for Bitcoin)
name: get_crypto_quote
